note: Summary of the experimental contact-spacing study of 2026-11-05 (foot_models/run_comparison.py --only discretisation, spacings 15, 10, 7.5, 5, 3.75 and 2.5 mm), run on the lab laptop (Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus, 22 cases at a time), copied from the run's summary.json with local paths reduced to file names; 'spacing_soles' (the sole files of each spacing) was added. Simulation only: not measured, not validated. A discretisation sensitivity, not a confidence interval or the total uncertainty (FOOT_MODELS.md 5.3, where the convergence criterion and verdict are). 'seconds' is each case's wall time with 22 cases running at once. The two-segment model is this machine's rebuild (sha256 e0898ca7..., PROVENANCE.json two_segment); the 15-5 mm cases equal results_2026-11-04.json in every field.
status: experimental: simulated foot-to-ground contact through a virtual sole, not foot-insole contact inside a shoe; registration is approximate (see registration_residuals); not validated against measurements; passive below the ankle (no muscles; ankle torque solved); quasi-static posture
